title: A complete solution to the biased Alon-Krivelevich-Spencer-Szabó criterion problem for the discrepancy game
summary: Let \(H=(V,\mathcal E)\) be a finite hypergraph. For positive integers \(p\) and \(q\), the \((p:q)\)-biased discrepancy game on \(H\) is played in complete rounds. In each round, Balancer first claims \(p\) previously unclaimed vertices, and then Unbalancer claims \(q\) previously unclaimed vertices. Let \(B\) and \(U\) be the final sets of vertices claimed by Balancer and Unbalancer, respectively. For an edge \(e\in\mathcal E\), define $D_e = q|B\cap e|-p|U\cap e| = (p+q)|B\cap e|-p|e|$.
